reference.text: But, though the world scouts at us whale hunters, yet does it unwittingly pay us the profoundest homage; yea, an all-abounding adoration!

underlines.text: do commercial homage to the whale-ship

reference.text: The whale has no famous author, and whaling no famous chronicler, you will say.
Good again; but then all confess that somehow whaling is not respectable.
The whale himself has never figured in any grand imposing way.

underlines.text: figured in any grand imposing way
